_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — quote-PDF TEXT-SHAPE business shape. Preserves the customer-facing PDF text-shape 9.3 compares, applying the 6.3 text-golden mustNotAppear leakage discipline: a HIDDEN row and an UNSELECTED option must NOT appear in the customer PDF (an empty mustNotAppear guards nothing, so it is a NON-EMPTY negative assertion). ZERO PII — synthetic company/customer labels, @example.test, no personnummer/orgnr/phone/address. This is a TEXT-shape oracle (the substrings that must / must not appear), NOT a raw PDF blob. Cases are origin:new-expected.

cases.note: The customer PDF shows the company + customer identity, the visible base lines, and the SELECTED option, but must NOT leak the hidden row's label or the unselected option's label. Preserves the 6.3 leakage discipline as a NON-EMPTY mustNotAppear negative assertion.
